stops.note: a Somerset town, probably 'farmstead of Weola's people'; Arthur Wellesley took his title from it in 1809, becoming Duke of Wellington in 1814
the Duke had his London bootmaker adapt the Hessian boot, and after Waterloo in 1815 'Wellingtons' became the fashion; rubber versions were first made in France by Hiram Hutchinson in the 1850s
